cards.hint: Recall what air would normally cause
cards.quote: On the Moon there is no air, so a thrown ball feels no drag at all.
cards.stem: What does a thrown object experience where there is no air present?

cards.hint: Think about the steady rate given for slowdown
cards.quote: On the Moon g is about 1.62 m/s^2, roughly one sixth
cards.stem: What value of downward pull slows the rise on the lunar surface?

cards.hint: Think about pushes to the side
cards.quote: Nothing pushes the ball sideways, so the horizontal speed stays U0 for the whole flight and the ball moves x = U0 * t across the ground.
cards.stem: How does sideways motion behave during the whole flight?

cards.hint: Think about putting rise time into height
cards.quote: Putting that time into the height equation gives the highest point: ymax = V0^2 / (2 * g).
cards.stem: Which expression gives the highest point of the rise?
